grammar.summary: 本课对比各种交通工具的优劣，大量运用条件状语从句（if 从句）讨论不同情况下的旅行体验，用现在分词作状语和定语描述旅行中的状态与感受，并通过比较级与最高级结构评判各种出行方式的舒适程度。

points.title: 条件状语从句 (Conditional Clauses)
points.explanation: if 引导的条件状语从句表示假设情况，主句用 would/could/may 等表达可能结果。本课用多个 if 从句讨论「若天气好」「若晕船」等假设场景，将不同出行方式的利弊进行对比。

examples.en: If you are lucky enough to get a sleeper, you spend half the night staring at the small blue light in the ceiling, or fumbling to find you ticket for inspection.
examples.cn: 即使你走运弄到一个卧铺，夜间有一半时间你会盯着车顶那盏小蓝灯而睡不着觉；要不然就为查票摸索你的车票。

examples.en: If it is not, and you are likely to get seasick, no form of transport could be worse.
examples.cn: 如果大海肆虐起来，你就可能晕船，那种难受劲儿是任何一种别的旅行的方式都不会带来的。

examples.en: If the landscape is hidden from view, you can enjoy the extraordinary sight of unbroken cloud plains that stretch out for miles before you, while the sun shines brilliantly in a clear sky.
examples.cn: 如果这种景色被遮住了，你可以观赏一下展现在你面前的、一望数英里的、连绵不断的云海，同时阳光灿烂，天空清澈明朗。

points.title: 现在分词作状语与定语 (Present Participles)
points.explanation: 现在分词可作状语表示伴随状态或作定语修饰名词。本课用分词短语 travelling at... 描述飞行时的状态，用 clicking on the rails 修饰 wheels 的声音，使描写生动而紧凑。

examples.en: Travelling at a height of 30,000 feet, far above the clouds, and at over 500 miles an hour is an exhilarating experience.
examples.cn: 腾云驾雾，在30，000 英尺高空以500英里的时速旅行，这种经历令人心旷神怡。

examples.en: Reading is only a partial solution, for the monotonous rhythm of the wheels clicking on the rails soon lulls you to sleep.
examples.cn: 看书只能解决部分问题。车轮与铁轨间单调的嘎喳声很快就会送你进入梦乡。

points.title: 比较级与最高级 (Comparative & Superlative)
points.explanation: 用比较级 less pleasant、more than 与无与伦比的 nothing can match 等结构对比不同交通工具的优劣。本课用 even less pleasant 贬低长途汽车，用 nothing can match them 赞美飞机的速度与舒适。

examples.en: Long car journeys are even less pleasant, for it is quite impossible even to read.
examples.cn: 乘汽车作长途旅行则更加不舒服，因为连看书都几乎不可能。

examples.en: But nothing can match them for speed and comfort.
examples.cn: 但就速度与舒适而言，飞机是无与伦比的。

exercises.q: ______ you are lucky enough to get a sleeper, you spend half the night staring at the small blue light in the ceiling, or fumbling to find you ticket for inspection.
Long car journeys are ______ less pleasant, for it is quite impossible even to read.
But nothing can ______ them for speed and comfort.
用分词形式填空：______ at a height of 30,000 feet, far above the clouds, and at over 500 miles an hour is an exhilarating experience.（写出 travel 的现在分词形式）
